news_articles.title: Egypt Launches New Renewable Energy Project
news_articles.description: The Egyptian government has announced a new solar and wind energy project aimed at reducing carbon emissions and supporting sustainable development.
news_articles.author: Daily News Egypt
highlights: Project will generate clean energy for over 1 million homes

news_articles.title: Tech Startups Thrive in Cairo
news_articles.description: Cairo’s startup ecosystem continues to grow as more young entrepreneurs enter the tech industry with innovative solutions.
news_articles.author: Tech Arabia

news_articles.title: New Cultural Festival Celebrates Egyptian Heritage
news_articles.description: A week-long cultural festival is set to take place in downtown Cairo, celebrating Egyptian art, music, and food.
news_articles.author: Cairo Culture
highlights: Open to the public for free
